select.if:
SELECT COUNTER_ID id,
COUNTER_NAME text, CASE WHEN T2.CUSTOMER_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'S' WHEN COUNTER_TYPE=#{COUNTER_TYPE} THEN #{YES_NO_N} ELSE #{YES_NO_Y} END "object" FROM MST_COUNTER_PARTY T1 LEFT JOIN MST_CUSTOMER_INFO T2 ON T1.LINK_ID = T2.CUSTOMER_ID
AND not exists (select 1 from PTL_PORTFOLIO p where p.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID) and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fin_product p WHERE p.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID)
AND exists (select 1 from PTL_PORTFOLIO p where p.PORTFOLIO_ID = T1.COUNTER_ID AND P.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y')
AND ( T1.COUNTER_ID LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) OR T1.COUNTER_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', CONCAT(#{search}, '%')) )
AND T1.COUNTER_ID = #{initValue}
AND T1.COUNTER_TYPE = #{counterType}
